title: Flow Cytometry Analysis of Mouse Islet Cell Expression of Heparan Sulfate and Proteoglycans
author: Sarah Popp
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bmsyk6fw

steps.title: Transfer and initial wash
steps.instruction: Transfer isolated mouse islets to a 15 ml tube, remove excess medium with a Pasteur pipette, resuspend in ~10–15 ml PBS containing 3 mM EDTA, and centrifuge at 249 g.

steps.title: Second PBS wash
steps.instruction: Carefully remove the supernatant, resuspend the pellet in PBS/3 mM EDTA, centrifuge again at 249 g, and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Accutase digestion
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in pre‑thawed Accutase (250 µl per 500 islets), place tubes in a 37 °C water bath for 10 min, gently tapping the pellet at 4 min and 8 min to aid resuspension.

substeps.instruction: Add Accutase at 250 µl per 500 islets.
Tap gently at 4 min and 8 min.

steps.title: Mechanical dissociation
steps.instruction: Dissociate the islets by pipetting up‑and‑down 10–15 times with a 1 ml single‑channel pipette.

steps.title: Terminate Accutase
steps.instruction: Add 10 ml culture medium to each tube to stop the Accutase reaction, then centrifuge for 5 min at 249 g.

steps.title: Resuspend and count cells
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant, resuspend the cell pellet in beta cell culture medium (500 µl per 500 islets), and determine cell density using a hemocytometer.

steps.title: Plate cells
steps.instruction: Transfer 4–8 × 10⁴ islet cells per well into a culture plate and adjust the volume in each well to 200 µl with beta cell culture medium.

steps.title: Centrifuge and remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the plates at 249 g for 3 min at 23 °C, then discard the supernatant by flicking.

steps.title: Fix and permeabilize
steps.instruction: For intracellular staining, resuspend cells in 100 µl BD Cytofix/Cytoperm, incubate 10 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Add wash buffer and spin
steps.instruction: Add 100 µl BD wash buffer, centrifuge at 249 g for 3 min at 23 °C, and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Wash cells
steps.instruction: Wash cells with 200 µl BD wash buffer, centrifuge at 249 g for 3 min at 23 °C, and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Add 25 µl per well of the chosen primary monoclonal antibody diluted in BD wash buffer to the following final concentrations: anti‑HS (10E4) 20 µg/ml, anti‑Col18 4 µg/ml, anti‑SDC1 20 µg/ml, anti‑CD44 40 µg/ml, or anti‑HPSE 1.5 µg/ml. Incubate 30 min on ice and protect from light.

steps.title: Wash after primary
steps.instruction: Wash the cells twice with BD wash buffer (repeat the wash step described in step 11 two times).

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Add 25 µl per well of the appropriate secondary antibody diluted in BD wash buffer to the following final concentrations: Goat anti‑mouse Ig PE 2.5 µg/ml (for HS and Col18) or 5 µg/ml, mouse anti‑rat κ PE 2 µg/ml (for SDC1 and CD44), rat anti‑mouse Ig FITC 10 µg/ml (for HPSE). Incubate 30 min on ice and protect from light.

substeps.instruction: Goat anti‑mouse Ig PE 2.5 µg/ml (or 5 µg/ml) – HS & Col18
Mouse anti‑rat κ PE 2 µg/ml – SDC1 & CD44
Rat anti‑mouse Ig FITC 10 µg/ml – HPSE

steps.title: Final wash and resuspend
steps.instruction: Wash the cells twice with BD wash buffer (as in step 11), then resuspend in 100 µl BD wash buffer, transfer each well to an individual microtube, and proceed to flow cytometry.

steps.title: Cell surface staining (alternative)
steps.instruction: For surface staining, repeat steps 9, 12‑16 using FACs wash buffer instead of BD wash buffer for all washes and antibody dilutions.

steps.title: Data acquisition and analysis
steps.instruction: Run each sample on a BD LSR Fortessa flow cytometer using BD FACS DIVA software (version 8); analyze the data with FlowJo software (version 10.0.7, TreeStar Inc.).
